snippet.title: My Otter Friends - Official Announcement Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for My Otter Friends, an action-adventure platformer developed by Polygoat. Players will explore a flooded island as a small otter. Meet stranded animals, restore nature, and bring warmth back to a world that has grown quiet. My Otter Friends is coming soon to PC (Steam).
